interpretation.fps: Rendered frame cadence, measured before pacing/clamping; target is separate. Hidden-tab intervals excluded.
interpretation.timing: CPU/Canvas submission only. Nested phases overlap: do not add parent and child durations.
interpretation.cpu: frameCpuBusyPercent covers measured frame JS only, not asynchronous callbacks or device-wide CPU utilisation.
interpretation.attribution: A gap BEFORE frame N may be caused by frame N-1, asynchronous work, rendering/compositing or OS scheduling; it is not proof that phase N caused it.
interpretation.unsupported: GPU utilisation, temperature, battery throttling, resident VRAM and GC pauses cannot be measured reliably here. Null means unavailable.
interpretation.retained: Rolling bounded samples; exports and sorting happen on demand, outside measured frames. No account names, tokens, payloads or coordinates recorded.
